decisionRationale: The exact candidate was replayed against current local public main without commit rewriting; main is an ancestor and the rebase was a no-op.
The design receipt still denies execution authorization, and no immutable owner authorization receipt or real terminal run record exists for any scheduled arm/task/edition/seed.

The only runnable CKS-05 materials in the candidate are explicitly labelled dry-run/scorer fixtures. They are excluded rather than relabelled as model invocations, benchmark executions, or architecture evidence.
The local Node build and selected CKS-05 test process both stopped at V8 Isolate initialization with exit 133/SIGTRAP before product execution. That is infrastructure evidence, not a product verdict.
